question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b11b06f07289b9c8c81e483305b5ae32bb9aa9f0dcbd575de6fc689921e9c0e4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) All elements shift in the anticlockwise direction.

2) Elements shifts by skipping parts i.e. 0, 1, 2, and 3 parts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6efa9a14d1c39e99f592aace534023fa4328454c6ae430a10e0fc4390e1b2b88.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e64183a7037090354eeb234b1093cda518701d018e61ba0e7999ad4d7eb67da.png] 

Hence. **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
